zigbee.spec: Zigbee 3.x / ZCL v8 (Espressif ESP Zigbee SDK v2.x)
zigbee.commercialSwitchBaseline: ZCL OnOff (0x0006) command on/off/toggle + attribute read 0x0000

coexistence.reason: 4MB flash cannot host stock MicroPython (~1.9MB) and ESP Zigbee stack in one image; modes are mutually exclusive opt-in full-flash targets
coexistence.wifiBleWithZigbee: Espressif documents multi-radio SoC capabilities; this M2A slice does not enable Wi-Fi SoftAP gateway or claim concurrent radio QA

artifact.blockReason: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 + esp-zigbee-lib toolchain not installed in this execution environment; binary produced only by firmware/esp32c6-zigbee-coordinator/build.sh when IDF is available

license.espZigbeeLib: Espressif prebuilt proprietary library via ESP Component Registry (espressif/esp-zigbee-lib); obtained at build time — not redistributed as source here

restoreMicroPython.note: Re-flash official MicroPython to restore USB REPL + pybot modules + ST7789 path
